ui.route.dbManagement.title: Database
ui.dbManagement.help.title: Help - Database Management
ui.dbManagement.help.whatIsDesc: A backup is a copy of your database. Think of it as a snapshot of all your data at a specific point in time. If something goes wrong, you can use this copy to recover your information.
ui.dbManagement.help.howToBackupSteps:
1. Go to the 'SQL Backup' tab
2. Click 'Download Backup'
3. The file will download to your computer
4. Save it in a safe place
ui.dbManagement.help.howToRestoreSteps:
1. Go to the 'Restore Database' tab
2. Click 'Select file' and choose your backup (.sql)
3. Click 'Restore Database'
4. Confirm the action in the popup window
5. Wait for the process to finish
ui.dbManagement.help.warningText: Restoring a backup will replace ALL current data. Make sure you have a recent backup before restoring.
